# Teregon Labs

> Teregon Labs is an environmental intelligence studio making environmental change easier to see, understand, and act on.

Teregon Labs connects landscape, watershed, and climate signals to help people build a clearer picture of a changing world and decide what to do next. Its work emphasizes place-based context, honest communication of uncertainty, and practical decisions for a living world.

## Applied systems

The site also features BrioBot (evidence-bound support case triage), Briopedia (a git-backed support knowledge base), BrioScope (support analytics), and Brio Sales Navigator (read-only sales forecasting and customer analytics). These are Brio product systems, not Teregon client engagements.

## Selected work

- BrioScope: customer support analytics that surfaces trending issues and live service signals.
- “From ridge to river” and “Where heat settles” are illustrative Teregon concept studies, not client engagements.

## Team

Misha Lubich, Joseph Heupler, and Yuvaraj Tankala.
